summary: Backend-only test for iteration 12 (P0 modal-queue is frontend-only, skipped). Verified 15/15 new/regression endpoints: POST /api/user/settings (discord_share_wins + leaderboard_optin toggle true->false, reflected via /api/auth/me), GET /api/discord/bot/stats (401 on missing/wrong x-bot-key, {linked:false} for unknown discord_id), GET /api/discord/bot/leaderboard (401 on bad key, returns {window, entries[]} with anonymized 'Trader-XXXX' aliases + trades>=3), POST /api/coach/transcribe (402 for free tier, 400/502 on invalid base64, real end-to-end round-trip: synthesized speech via emergentintegrations OpenAITextToSpeech tts-1/wav using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, base64-encoded, POSTed with summarize=true, got non-empty text+summary back), plus regression on /api/dashboard/stats, /api/config, /api/gex.

minor.issue: Invalid base64 payload is not always rejected with 400. Python's base64.b64decode is lenient (silently ignores stray chars), so garbage passes decode and only fails downstream at Whisper -> 502. Consider using validate=True on b64decode so obviously-bad input returns 400 as the endpoint contract implies.

action_items: (Optional) Harden POST /api/coach/transcribe: use base64.b64decode(inp.audio_base64, validate=True) so malformed base64 consistently returns 400 (currently sometimes falls through to a 502 from Whisper).
DISCORD_WINS_CHANNEL_ID is empty in backend/.env — auto-post-to-#wins is a no-op in this env, as expected. Populate before shipping if the feature should be live.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2064 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth/, discord/, trades/, coach/, payments/) for maintainability.
coach_transcribe correctly opens the temp file as a file object (fh) when calling OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe — matches the note in the review request.
anon_alias uses sha256(discord_id||user_id) truncated to 4 hex chars → OK for anonymization; collisions possible in a small pool but acceptable for a leaderboard.
Bot-key auth for /api/discord/bot/* is header-based and constant-time-ish via ==; fine for a shared secret behind HTTPS.
